name: dftracer_provenance_annotate
description: dftracer provenance mode, annotation stage: from the user-approved provenance/spec.yaml, install the dftracer_prov helper (dftracer_prov.h / dftracer_prov.py) and entity-type registry, insert idempotent dft-prov entity/activity calls (C, C++, Python) into <WS>/provenance/source, make main() initialize/finalize dftracer, and gate statically on the spec. Load when annotating for provenance, or on 'no dftracer_prov helper in tree', 'type registry is stale', 'entity type ... from spec is never recorded in code', 'activity ... is never opened in code', 'uses dft_prov but does not #include', 'dftracer is never initialized', a 0-byte provenance trace, or a run that exits 0 with an empty graph.

history.why: converted from dftracer-agents provenance.py (install_helpers/insert/ensure_lifecycle/validate tools), skill dftracer-provenance (runtime API, run configuration, lessons) and agent dftracer-provenance-annotate
